summary: Filing is an 8-K (Item 8.01) by Fathom Holdings Inc. disclosing receipt of a Nasdaq compliance notice. The company had been delinquent in filing its Q1 2026 10-Q but remedied the issue on July 16, 2026, leading Nasdaq to confirm compliance with Listing Rule 5250(c)(1) on July 17, 2026. No transaction, strategic review, or special situation is present. The filing is a routine regulatory compliance update with no deal terms, advisor involvement, or structural mechanics. This is not a special situation; the only event is a cured filing delinquency.
